homeBioParagraphs: Amanda Dee is a music director and classically-trained pianist and violinist based in NYC and the Bay Area.

Regional (selected): Twelfth Night MD (ACT San Francisco), Bad News Bears Music Assistant (workshop+ACT SF premiere), My Fair Lady MD (American Theater Group), The Full Monty Key 2 sub (The Gateway Playhouse), Mary Poppins Piano 1 (Brick Church Community Theater), My Fair Lady Violin 2 (SF Playhouse), numerous at Ray of Light Theatre SF. She also regularly plays auditions and loves to sight read.
New works: Big Man (Music Assistant), A Most Immoral Woman (Across A Crowded Room NYPL + Spark Theatre Festival Music Director).

One of her greatest musical passions is educational theatre. New York: Shuffles, TADA Youth Theater, Applause NY. Bay Area: American Conservatory Theatre Young Conservatory and Berkeley Playhouse YouthStage. She takes pride in connecting with young performers and helping them explore their identity and personality through the performing arts.

BS in Bioengineering, minors in Music and Mathematics (Northeastern University), PhD Candidate in Plant Biology (UC Berkeley). Outside of the rehearsal room, she can be found playing video games, rock climbing, or biking.

homeTestimonials.quote: Amanda Dee's musical direction, with Sharon Ahn joining her on the piano, provides first-rate accompaniment for the glorious melodies and clever lyrics.
Masterfully directed by ATG's Producing Artistic Director, Jim Vagias with choreography by Victoria Casillo and Musical Direction by Amanda Dee this show is a real crowd-pleaser.
Singular instruments often sing in mesmerizing duets with the actors onstage, especially Amanda Dee's violin and Myra Chachkin's cello.
